items.description: The boundary layer (app/routes/) contains no ORM or session imports (layering + ORM-only contract)
The service layer (app/services/) contains no ORM or session imports (ORM-only contract: only the repository touches the ORM)
DATABASE_URL is sourced from the environment and never hardcoded in any application module
The real branch database enforces NOT NULL on sku, location, and quantity so that inserting a row with any of those columns null raises a constraint violation

Given no stock record exists for a unique SKU-location pair, when an operator files with sku, location, quantity, and tracking-code, then a new record is created and reading it back returns exactly those filed values

The Alembic migration is reversible: after a single-step downgrade followed by upgrade against the real branch, the stock_records table exists with its sku/location/quantity NOT NULL columns, the composite UNIQUE (sku, location) constraint, and the CHECK quantity >= 0 constraint (schema-recreation, not row survival)
Given a stock record already exists for a SKU-location pair, when an operator files again for the same pair with a different quantity, then the existing record's quantity is updated in place
Given a stock record already exists for a SKU-location pair, when an operator files again for the same pair with a different quantity, then exactly one record exists for that pair after the operation
The real branch database enforces a unique constraint on (sku, location) so that inserting a duplicate pair raises a constraint violation
The service layer raises a validation error for a negative quantity before any database write is attempted
Given an operator files a stock record with a quantity below zero, then the filing is rejected with a response message that names the quantity field
Given an operator files a stock record with a quantity below zero, then no record is created or changed in the store
The real branch database enforces CHECK quantity >= 0 so that inserting a row with a negative quantity raises a constraint violation
